app.title: MetersetMap Comparison: planned against delivered radiotherapy fluence
app.summary: The person chooses a configuration mode: upload and download files only, or bundled demo data. They then pick a reference treatment plan, either by uploading a DICOM RT Plan file or by searching a planning-system export location. Next they pick the evaluation delivery, either by uploading linac log (TRF) files or by searching an indexed log directory. A sidebar overview shows the patient identifiers and total MU of each side so the person can check the two match. The app computes the MetersetMap for each side, compares them with a gamma pass rate, and writes the result to a configured output location, such as a scanned-documents (eSCAN) directory for the record.

task.text: Check that a delivered radiotherapy treatment, read from linac log files, matches its plan by comparing the MetersetMap fluence of each.

data.text: A treatment plan as a DICOM RT Plan and the matching machine delivery logs, each turned into a 2D MetersetMap (MU fluence) grid built from MLC and jaw positions weighted by MU.
data.item: a pair of one planned treatment and its recorded delivery for a single patient

stage.text: checking a delivered treatment against its plan after delivery, as patient-specific QA

mechanism.text: Two side-by-side columns set the reference (plan) source against the evaluation (delivery log) source, each with a radio choice of import method and a file uploader or directory search. A sidebar summarises both sides' identifiers and total MU so the person can check them before the maps are computed, compared and written to an output directory.

field.text: patient-specific QA comparing planned and log-file-delivered fluence in radiotherapy medical physics

workflow.name: compare a planned specification with a recorded execution and report agreement

steps.here: A Config Mode radio picks file upload/download only or demo data, which sets where reference and evaluation files can come from.
Under Reference, a DICOM import method radio offers file upload of an RT Plan or a search of the Monaco file export location.

steps.step: choose the item to evaluate against it
steps.here: Under Evaluation, a TRF import method radio offers upload of TRF log files or a search of an indexed TRF directory.

steps.step: check the two sides belong together
steps.here: The sidebar MetersetMap Overview lists Patient ID, Patient Name and Total MU for Reference and for Evaluation.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: A MetersetMap is calculated for the plan and for the logs and compared with gamma, giving a pass rate.
Output Locations name where the result goes, such as an eSCAN directory of logfile PDFs.

distinctive: The reference is a treatment plan and the evaluation is the linac's own delivery log, so the check compares intended against recorded machine motion, not measured dose.
Total MU and patient identifiers on both sides are shown together as a sanity check before comparing.
Each side can come from a manual upload or from a search of a site-configured directory (planning-system exports, an indexed log archive).
Agreement is judged with a gamma pass rate over the fluence grid.
The result goes to a department's scanned-documents directory as part of the patient record.
